title: Hivemind: A Federated Protocol for AI-Mediated Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Organisations
abstract: arXiv:2611.20988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents Hivemind, a federated protocol that enables AI agents to exchange tacit knowledge on behalf of their users, asynchronously and without requiring any direct human interaction. Individual AI memory systems capture the decisions, reasoning, and contextual knowledge that surface during AI-assisted work. Hivemind creates the shared space in which this captured knowledge can flow between individuals across team and departmental boundaries, addressing a structural gap that neither centralised knowledge repositories nor existing AI tooling closes, even where partial solutions such as expert-finding systems exist. The paper evaluates centralised versus decentralised design approaches, proposes a federated architecture grounded in Nonaka and Takeuchi's (1995) Socialisation, Externalisation, Combination and Internalisation (SECI) model, and demonstrates a proof-of-concept implementation using Design Science Research (DSR) method

translated_title: Hivemind：一种用于AI介导的组织内隐性知识共享的联邦协议
translated_abstract: 本文提出了Hivemind，这是一种联邦协议，使AI智能体能够代表其用户交换隐性知识，整个过程异步进行且无需任何直接的人际互动。个人AI记忆系统捕获在AI辅助工作过程中涌现的决策、推理和上下文知识。Hivemind创建了一个共享空间，使这些被捕获的知识能够在跨越团队和部门边界的个体之间流动，填补了集中式知识库和现有AI工具都无法解决的结构性空白，即使存在专家查找系统等部分解决方案的情况下也是如此。本文评估了集中式与去中心化的设计方法，提出了一种基于野中郁次郎与竹内弘高（1995）提出的社会化、外化、组合化、内化（SECI）模型的联邦架构，并通过设计科学研究（DSR）方法演示了概念验证实现。
tldr: 本文提出Hivemind——一种基于SECI知识转化模型的联邦协议，使AI智能体能够异步地在组织内跨团队与部门边界共享用户的隐性知识，填补了集中式知识库和现有AI工具都无法解决的组织知识流动结构性空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Hivemind, a federated protocol grounded in the SECI knowledge conversion model, which enables AI agents to asynchronously share users' tacit knowledge across organisational boundaries, addressing a structural gap that neither centralised knowledge repositories nor existing AI tooling can close.
